name: mira-release
description: Not a JavaScript project. This file exists so @changesets/cli can see the two things Mira versions independently: the engine (Cargo.toml's [workspace.package] version) and the operator (charts/mira-operator/Chart.yaml). The units under release/units/ hold one number each and nothing else. crates/mira/ui is deliberately NOT a member: npm reroutes an install run from inside a workspace member up to the root, and `make ui`'s `git diff --exit-code dist` would stop being reproducible.
